description: Browse or search only publicly readable SuperCatch documentation. Use for public how-to questions: omit query for the table of contents, or select documentId to restrict the document. Account-restricted and staff guides are excluded; API discovery links and help-page navigation are separate resources. Returns documents and cited passages with URLs, versions and review dates; query plus documentId searches only that document. Public; no sign-in required. Read-only; no account connection or content edits. Unknown/invisible documents and unmatched words return empty results; invalid query parameters return a tool error.

documentId.description: Exact document id from the table of contents; omit to search all visible documents. With no query, returns that document.

limit.description: Maximum documentation results to return (1-20); defaults to 10.

query.description: Plain-text search words; omit for the table of contents, or combine with documentId to search within one document.

name: search_public_docs
